subject.title: fix: stop repeated message_tool_only source replies

question: Should message_tool_only enforce at most one implicit current-source visible reply per embedded run while preserving later non-message tool execution?
rationale: This invariant sits between the prior continuation fix and the Telegram cascade regression, and the repository already labels the linked bug as needing maintainer/product review.

options.title: Accept one implicit source reply
options.body: Preserve non-message follow-up tools, suppress later implicit current-source sends, and require full visible-channel proof before merge.

options.title: Restore terminate-after-delivery
options.body: End the run after the first delivered source reply, stopping cascades but risking the prior follow-up-tool regression.

options.title: Keep current continuation behavior
options.body: Leave repeated source sends possible until owners choose a different lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Accept one implicit source reply
recommendation.body: Preserve non-message follow-up tools, suppress later implicit current-source sends, and require full visible-channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the continuation behavior that this PR must preserve or intentionally revise.
